scenarios.title: Settings map
scenarios.description: A synthetic settings schema as a weighted hierarchy: one equal circle per key, nested under its owner, colored by kind, with every further flag as a dot. The definition makes secrets danger red and pre-releases warning amber, and names secret keys; the other kinds take the most distinct free colors. A provider gains a secret key, a pre-release key leaves and a key stops being hidden.
